title: repeated extra help
rule: When the same error repeats (three or more times in one attempt), provide extra help: review error patterns, refine the design, and make messages more actionable.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§10)

pass_when: On the third-or-more same error in one attempt, the UI offers extra help and more actionable copy than the first showing.
fail_when: The same error copy repeats three or more times with no added help.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
